findings.claim: D-51 drops GAUNTLET_TEST_COMMAND, but its rows are only P11 and H1, so it leaves contracts row P19 and node `settings`' "test" key (worktree-cut-design.md:168-169) still promising a whole test command in gauntlet/settings.json; no decision found in CONTEXT.md removes either.
findings.failure_scenario: The ruling is applied as written: the guard, writing-design.md:528 and the example drop the variable. P19 still says settings.json holds 'the repository's test command'. A Phase 2 builder following P19 and :168 writes "test" from a variable no repository now sets, so it records "test": "". Or the builder puts GAUNTLET_TEST_COMMAND back to fill the key. Either way the contract row and the env contract disagree, and the reader-less key G-78 set out to remove stays.
